title: Direct Forcing: A Single-Stage Training Recipe for Few-Step Autoregressive Text-to-Video Generation
title_zh: 直接强制：少步自回归文生视频生成的单阶段训练配方

paragraphs.en: Few-step autoregressive video generation enables low-latency streaming, yet prevailing training pipelines separate causal adaptation from distribution matching. Recent representation-based text-to-video methods retain this separation by starting from ODE-initialized checkpoints, even when the target distribution is defined directly by reference videos. We introduce Direct Forcing, a single-stage framework that uses reference videos both as paired examples of how a history continues and as a target population for self-generated rollouts. Causal Continuation Alignment learns paired spatiotemporal correspondence under reference histories, while Rollout Distribution Matching uses maximum mean discrepancy to align the representation distributions of self-generated and reference videos. Together, these complementary signals allow a pretrained video model to learn causal continuation and the target video distribution in a single training stage. Dynamic Gradient Balancing adapts the relative gradient contributions of continuation alignment and distribution matching during training. Starting from bidirectional Wan2.1-1.3B, Direct Forcing learns a four-step autoregressive generator in 250 updates without a separate initialization stage or online diffusion-score supervision, achieving 84.63 VBench Total and 86.01 Quality. Ablation studies further demonstrate the benefits of dynamic gradient balancing and reveal distinct representation preferences: deeper features benefit continuation alignment, whereas intermediate features yield better performance for rollout distribution matching.
paragraphs.zh: 少步自回归视频生成能够实现低延迟流式传输，然而主流的训练流程将因果适配与分布匹配分离开来。 近期基于表示的文本到视频方法保留了这种分离，它们从 ODE 初始化的检查点出发，即使目标分布是直接由参考视频定义的。 我们提出 Direct Forcing，这是一个单阶段框架，它将参考视频同时用作历史如何延续的成对样本，以及自生成 rollout 的目标总体。 因果延续对齐在参考历史的条件下学习成对的时空对应关系，而 rollout 分布匹配则利用最大均值差异来对齐自生成视频与参考视频的表示分布。 这两种互补信号结合在一起，使预训练视频模型能够在单个训练阶段中同时学习因果延续和目标视频分布。 动态梯度平衡在训练过程中自适应地调整延续对齐与分布匹配的相对梯度贡献。 从双向 Wan2.1-1.3B 出发，Direct Forcing 在 250 次更新内学习到一个四步自回归生成器，无需单独的初始化阶段或在线扩散分数监督，取得了 84.63 的 VBench 总分和 86.01 的质量分。 消融研究进一步证明了动态梯度平衡的收益，并揭示了不同的表示偏好：更深的特征有利于延续对齐，而中间层特征则在 rollout 分布匹配上带来更好的性能。

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion generates temporal chunks sequentially, conditioning each chunk on previously produced content. This streaming factorization is attractive for interactive applications—world modeling, game simulation, embodied control, and content creation—where users or agents must steer generation as it unfolds [ 37 , 16 , 34 ] . The obstacle is latency: evaluating a diffusion network many times for each chunk can exceed the playback budget, even when the model generates causally. Practical real-time interaction therefore calls for a few-step causal generator. The challenge is to obtain one from a strong pretrained bidirectional video model.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归（AR）视频扩散按时间块顺序生成，每个块都以之前生成的内容为条件。 这种流式分解对交互式应用极具吸引力——世界建模、游戏模拟、具身控制和内容创作——在这些应用中，用户或智能体必须在生成过程中对其进行引导 [37, 16, 34]。 障碍在于延迟：对每个块多次评估扩散网络可能超出播放预算，即使模型是以因果方式生成的。 因此，实用的实时交互需要一种少步因果生成器。 挑战在于如何从一个强大的预训练双向视频模型中获得这样的生成器。

paragraphs.en: To improve efficiency, recent works distill pretrained multi-step models into few-step generators [ 37 , 16 , 41 ] . Distribution matching distillation (DMD) [ 36 , 35 ] trains a student to match the teacher’s output distribution by comparing diffusion scores from a pretrained teacher and a learned fake-score model on student-generated samples. For AR video generation, Self Forcing [ 16 ] and Causal Forcing [ 41 ] use bidirectional and causal ODE initialization, respectively, to narrow the initial student–teacher distribution gap and enable more effective on-policy distillation with DMD.
paragraphs.zh: 为了提高效率，近期的工作将预训练的多步模型蒸馏为少步生成器 [37, 16, 41]。 分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）[36, 35] 通过比较预训练教师模型与学习到的伪分数模型在智能体生成样本上的扩散分数，训练学生模型去匹配教师模型的输出分布。 在自回归（AR）视频生成方面，Self Forcing [16] 和 Causal Forcing [41] 分别使用双向和因果的 ODE 初始化，以缩小初始时学生与教师之间的分布差距，从而实现更有效的基于 DMD 的在策略蒸馏。

paragraphs.en: More recently, ViRDM [ 24 ] and Elastic Forcing [ 38 ] replace DMD with representation distribution matching based on maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), directly supervising few-step generators with reference videos through frozen encoders, without an online diffusion teacher or a learned fake-score model. Yet their standard text-to-video recipes still start from ODE-initialized checkpoints. Since MMD defines its supervision directly from generated and reference samples, prior alignment with a diffusion teacher is not a prerequisite of the objective. We therefore ask whether causal adaptation and rollout distribution matching can instead be learned jointly from reference videos, without a separate initialization stage .
paragraphs.zh: 最近，ViRDM [ 24 ] 和 Elastic Forcing [ 38 ] 用基于最大均值差异（MMD）的表征分布匹配取代了 DMD，通过冻结编码器直接用参考视频监督少步生成器，而无需在线扩散教师或学习到的假分数模型。 然而它们的标准文生视频方案仍然从 ODE 初始化的检查点开始。 由于 MMD 直接从生成样本和参考样本定义其监督信号，与扩散教师的预先对齐并非该目标的先决条件。 因此我们提出疑问：因果自适应与 rollout 分布匹配能否改为直接从参考视频中联合学习，而无需单独的初始化阶段。

paragraphs.en: Reference videos provide the supervision needed for such joint learning: each video supplies paired examples of how a history continues, while the reference population defines the target distribution for self-generated rollouts. Population matching alone, however, does not explicitly supervise the correspondence between a given history and its continuation. The temporal discontinuities under direct MMD-only training in Figure 2 therefore motivate combining explicit continuation supervision with rollout distribution matching from the start.
paragraphs.zh: 参考视频为这种联合学习提供了所需的监督信号：每个视频提供关于一段历史如何延续的成对样本，同时参考群体为自生成的 rollout 定义了目标分布。 然而，仅靠群体匹配并不能显式地监督给定历史与其延续之间的对应关系。 因此，图 2 中仅在直接 MMD 训练下出现的时间不连续性，促使我们从一开始就将显式的延续监督与 rollout 分布匹配相结合。

paragraphs.en: Direct Forcing implements this joint training through two complementary components. Causal Continuation Alignment (CCA) aligns predicted and reference spatiotemporal features under reference histories. Since these histories do not contain accumulated prediction errors, Rollout Distribution Matching (RDM) additionally supervises complete videos generated under the model’s own histories, matching their joint video–text representation distribution to the reference population through MMD. Both components update the same generator from the start, so causal continuation is learned together with the rollout distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 直接强迫（Direct Forcing）通过两个互补的组件实现这种联合训练。 因果延续对齐（CCA）在参考历史条件下对齐预测与参考的时空特征。 由于这些历史不包含累积的预测误差，滚动分布匹配（RDM）进一步对模型自身历史条件下生成的完整视频进行监督，通过 MMD 使其联合视频-文本表示分布与参考总体相匹配。 两个组件从一开始就更新同一个生成器，因此因果延续与滚动分布是一起学习的。

Gradient norm matching establishes a common gradient scale, while residual error weighting adjusts the relative contribution of continuation alignment according to its current fitting residual. paragraphs.en: CausVid [ 37 ] combines ODE initialization with DMD for few-step causal generation. Self Forcing [ 16 ] and Causal Forcing [ 41 ] use bidirectional and causal ODE initialization, respectively, followed by DMD on student rollouts. Matrix-Game 3.5 [ 26 ] uses teacher-forced perceptual flow matching for few-step causal initialization, then improves self-generated rollouts with DMD. Direct Forcing instead optimizes causal continuation and rollout distribution matching in a single training stage.
paragraphs.zh: CausVid [ 37 ] 将 ODE 初始化与 DMD 相结合，实现少步因果生成。 Self Forcing [ 16 ] 和 Causal Forcing [ 41 ] 分别使用双向和因果 ODE 初始化，随后在智能体自身展开的序列上进行 DMD。 Matrix-Game 3.5 [ 26 ] 使用教师强制的感知流匹配进行少步因果初始化，然后用 DMD 改进智能体自身生成的展开序列。 Direct Forcing 则在单一训练阶段中同时优化因果延续与展开序列的分布匹配。

paragraphs.en: Early sample-based generators optimize MMD between generated and reference populations [ 22 , 9 ] , using differences between kernel mean embeddings [ 13 ] . Recent methods compare learned representations through attraction–repulsion fields [ 8 ] , feature moments [ 33 , 23 , 12 ] , or Sinkhorn-divergence gradient flows [ 15 ] . RDM [ 10 ] applies MMD under frozen pretrained encoders, allowing reference summaries to be computed offline. ViRDM [ 24 ] and Elastic Forcing [ 38 ] extend this approach to causal rollouts with memory-efficient differentiation and reference estimation. Their standard T2V recipes inherit ODE-initialized checkpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 早期基于样本的生成器通过使用核均值嵌入之间的差异，来优化生成群体与参考群体之间的 MMD [22, 9]。 近期方法通过吸引—排斥场 [8]、特征矩 [33, 23, 12] 或 Sinkhorn 散度梯度流 [15] 来比较学习到的表示。 RDM [10] 在冻结的预训练编码器下应用 MMD，使参考摘要可以离线计算。 ViRDM [24] 和 Elastic Forcing [38] 借助内存高效的反向求导与参考估计，将该方法扩展到因果式 rollout。 它们的标准 T2V 训练配方继承了由 ODE 初始化的检查点。

paragraphs.en: Direct Forcing jointly adapts a pretrained bidirectional model for few-step autoregressive generation in a single stage (Figure 3 ). Causal Continuation Alignment (CCA; Sec. 3.2 ) supervises predictions under reference histories through paired spatiotemporal feature alignment. Rollout Distribution Matching (RDM; Sec. 3.3 ) uses MMD to match feature distributions of self-generated rollouts and reference videos. Dynamic Gradient Balancing (Sec. 3.4 ) controls both objectives’ relative gradient contributions to the shared generator.
paragraphs.zh: 直接强制（Direct Forcing）在单一阶段内联合适配一个预训练双向模型，使其用于少步自回归生成（图 3）。 因果续接对齐（Causal Continuation Alignment，CCA；第 3.2 节）通过成对的时空特征对齐，在参考历史的条件下监督预测。 滚动分布匹配（Rollout Distribution Matching，RDM；第 3.3 节）使用 MMD 来匹配智能体自生成滚动序列与参考视频的特征分布。 动态梯度平衡（第 3.4 节）控制两个目标对共享生成器的相对梯度贡献。

paragraphs.en: We initialize Direct Forcing from pretrained bidirectional Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B [ 30 ] and generate 81-frame (21-latent-frame) videos at 832 × 480 832\times 480 resolution in autoregressive chunks of three latent frames. Unless otherwise specified, training and inference use four denoising steps with timestep shift 5. We perform 250 joint updates on eight NVIDIA B200 GPUs using 6,505 reference video–prompt pairs released by Causal Forcing [ 41 ] . Each update uses 128 generated videos for RDM and 32 reference pairs for CCA. Our main configuration uses VideoMAE v2 [ 31 ] L24 for CCA and VideoMAE v2 L16 plus DiT L9 for RDM, with frozen SigLIP2 [ 29 ] prompt embeddings for the MMD kernel. The generator retains its native text encoder. DiT features come from frozen Wan2.1-T2V-14B [ 30 ] . Reference features and prompt embeddings are precomputed offline. Appendices A – B detail the implementation; Appendix D examines DiT feature choices.

paragraphs.en: Direct Forcing reaches this performance through 250 joint updates directly from the bidirectional backbone, without a separate initialization stage. ViRDM inherits Causal Forcing’s causal ODE initialization, while Elastic Forcing inherits Self Forcing’s bidirectional ODE initialization. The chunk-boundary ratio compares frame differences at boundaries and within chunks, normalized by the corresponding reference-video ratio. Our ratio is closer to one than ViRDM’s (1.040 vs. 1.393; Appendix E.3 ), supporting temporal continuity without a separate initialization stage.

paragraphs.en: With fixed weights, CCA gradients dominate RDM throughout training, with an initial norm ratio of 15.9 (Figure 4 (a)). GNM corrects this imbalance, improving Total from 80.43 to 81.23 and Dynamic from 31.11 to 37.22 (Table 4 ). Under GNM alone, the CCA loss falls to 28% of its initial value by update 150 (Figure 4 (b)), motivating residual-based adjustment of the continuation contribution. paragraphs.zh: 在固定权重下，CCA 梯度在整个训练过程中主导 RDM，初始范数比为 15.9（图 4 (a)）。 GNM 校正了这一不平衡，将 Total 从 80.43 提升到 81.23，将 Dynamic 从 31.11 提升到 37.22（表 4）。 仅使用 GNM 时，CCA 损失在第 150 次更新时降至其初始值的 28%（图 4 (b)），这促使我们基于残差对延续贡献进行调整。 加入 REW 后，Total 进一步提升至 82.40，Dynamic 提升至 54.72，而 Semantic 几乎不变，支持其在范数校准之外的有益作用。

paragraphs.en: We adapt the 150-update short-video checkpoint with 100 further updates using only the original 6,505 short reference videos. Following window-based long-rollout training [ 6 ] , RDM supervises approximately five-second windows sampled from self-generated rollouts of up to approximately 60 seconds. We match their globally pooled VideoMAE v2 L16 and DiT L9 features to the short-reference distribution, while retaining token-level CCA with VideoMAE v2 L24 throughout adaptation. Thus, adaptation learns from long generated histories without long references or an online diffusion teacher.
paragraphs.zh: 我们仅使用原始的 6,505 个短视频参考视频，对 150 次更新的短视频检查点再进行 100 次更新的适配。 遵循基于窗口的长时程展开训练 [ 6 ]，RDM 对从最长约 60 秒的自生成展开中采样的约五秒窗口进行监督。 我们将其全局池化的 VideoMAE v2 L16 与 DiT L9 特征匹配到短视频参考分布，同时在整个适配过程中保留与 VideoMAE v2 L24 的 token 级 CCA。 因此，适配过程从长时程生成历史中学习，而无需长参考视频或在线扩散教师模型。

paragraphs.en: Direct Forcing outperforms Self-Forcing++ [ 6 ] on four of six VBench-Long [ 18 ] metrics, with lower Dynamic Degree and Imaging Quality (Table 10 ; details in Appendix F ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 VBench-Long [18] 的六项指标中，Direct Forcing 有四项优于 Self-Forcing++ [6]，且具有更低的动态程度（Dynamic Degree）和成像质量（Imaging Quality）（表 10；详情见附录 F）。

paragraphs.en: We presented Direct Forcing, a single-stage framework that directly adapts a pretrained bidirectional video model into a four-step autoregressive generator in 250 joint updates, without a separate initialization stage. Causal Continuation Alignment learns paired continuations under reference histories, while Rollout Distribution Matching aligns self-generated rollouts with the reference population. Dynamic Gradient Balancing controls their relative gradient contributions as continuation fitting progresses. Our ablations support both gradient-balancing components and objective-specific representation choices, including the benefit of combining features for rollout distribution matching. The resulting model achieves 84.63 VBench Total and 86.01 Quality. Short references also support 50-second generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Direct Forcing，这是一个单阶段框架，能够在 250 次联合更新中直接将预训练的双向视频模型适配为四步自回归生成器，无需单独的初始化阶段。 因果续写对齐在参考历史条件下学习成对的续写内容，而滚动分布匹配则将模型自生成的滚动结果与参考分布对齐。 动态梯度平衡在续写拟合推进过程中控制二者相对的梯度贡献。 我们的消融实验同时支持了梯度平衡的两个组成部分以及针对各目标的表示选择，包括为滚动分布匹配组合多种特征所带来的收益。 最终模型在 VBench 上取得了 84.63 的总分和 86.01 的质量分。 短参考视频还能支持 50 秒的生成。

sents.zh: 因果续写对齐在参考历史条件下学习成对的续写内容，而滚动分布匹配则将模型自生成的滚动结果与参考分布对齐。

sents.en: Dynamic Gradient Balancing controls their relative gradient contributions as continuation fitting progresses.
sents.zh: 动态梯度平衡在续写拟合推进过程中控制二者相对的梯度贡献。

sents.en: Our ablations support both gradient-balancing components and objective-specific representation choices, including the benefit of combining features for rollout distribution matching.
sents.zh: 我们的消融实验同时支持了梯度平衡的两个组成部分以及针对各目标的表示选择，包括为滚动分布匹配组合多种特征所带来的收益。

sents.en: The resulting model achieves 84.63 VBench Total and 86.01 Quality.
sents.zh: 最终模型在 VBench 上取得了 84.63 的总分和 86.01 的质量分。

paragraphs.en: The generator is initialized from pretrained bidirectional Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B. An 81-frame video is represented by 21 latent frames, partitioned into seven chunks of three latent frames. Attention is bidirectional within each chunk and causal across chunks. The four normalized noise levels are { 1 , 0.9375 , 0.8333 , 0.625 } \{1,0.9375,0.8333,0.625\} , obtained from the base four-step schedule with timestep shift five. Self-forcing rollouts use the shared exit and gradient truncation in Eq. ( 6 ).

paragraphs.en: The VideoMAE v2 encoder has 24 transformer blocks. We discard RGB frame 0 and divide the remaining 80 frames into five chronological clips of 16 frames. Each clip produces 1,568 tokens. CCA averages token-wise cosine distance over all 7,840 tokens. RDM selects 256 ordered positions per clip, yielding 1,280 tokens per video. L16 and L24 refer to the raw post-residual outputs of blocks 16 and 24, respectively. The main visual configuration uses L24 for CCA and L16 for RDM.
paragraphs.zh: VideoMAE v2 编码器包含 24 个 transformer 块。 我们丢弃 RGB 第 0 帧，并将剩余的 80 帧按时间顺序划分为五个 16 帧的片段。 每个片段产生 1,568 个 token。 CCA 对全部 7,840 个 token 逐 token 计算余弦距离并取平均。 RDM 从每个片段中选取 256 个有序位置，每个视频得到 1,280 个 token。 L16 和 L24 分别指块 16 和块 24 在残差相加之后的原始输出。 主要视觉配置将 L24 用于 CCA，将 L16 用于 RDM。

paragraphs.en: In our tested configuration, optical-flow regularization improves Total and Dynamic Degree (Table 14 ) but reduces Temporal Flickering, Motion Smoothness, Aesthetic Quality, and Imaging Quality scores (Table 15 ). Visual inspection also reveals implausible shaking. These observations suggest that rewarding displacement magnitude can increase measured motion without ensuring plausible temporal dynamics. We therefore omit this auxiliary objective from our main configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们测试的配置中，光流正则化提升了总体分数和动态程度（表 14），但降低了时序闪烁、运动平滑度、美学质量和成像质量得分（表 15）。 视觉检查也发现了不合理的抖动。 这些观察表明，奖励位移大小可以提升测量到的运动，却不能保证合理的时间动态。 因此，我们在主配置中省略了这一辅助目标。

paragraphs.en: Table 16 compares two representations for rollout distribution matching, using VideoMAE v2 L16 for both training components and retaining full-token cosine supervision for continuation alignment. Global pooling averages all 7,840 video tokens into a single 1,024-dimensional vector. The token representation retains 256 fixed, ordered tokens from each of five clips, then flattens the resulting 1,280 tokens and divides by 1280 \sqrt{1280} . Reference summaries and kernel bandwidths are recomputed for each representation. Both variants use 150 joint updates and the same 4,720-video evaluation protocol.

paragraphs.en: Table 19 shows that forward noising reduces the feature response by 27.3% for cross-video splicing and by 22.7% for temporal freezing. paragraphs.en: We construct a corpus of 1,171 Seedance 2.5-generated videos with substantial motion and English descriptions, manually excluding videos with implausible motion. For each 5–20-second source clip, we sample frames across its full duration to construct a five-second reference sequence. Both CCA and RDM are trained on this corpus for 150 updates, using VideoMAE v2 L16 for both components and RDM/CCA batch sizes of 64/32. RDM uses a reference bank containing the complete curated corpus. We compare this model with the corresponding L16/L16 model trained on the original 6,505 reference videos, evaluating both with the full VBench suite.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了一个包含 1,171 个 Seedance 2.5 生成视频的语料库，这些视频具有大幅运动和英文描述，并人工排除了运动不合理的视频。 对于每个 5–20 秒的源片段，我们在其整个持续时间上采样帧，构建一个五秒的参考序列。 CCA 和 RDM 都在该语料库上训练 150 次更新，两个组件均使用 VideoMAE v2 L16，RDM/CCA 的批大小分别为 64/32。 RDM 使用包含完整筛选后语料库的参考库。 我们将该模型与在原始 6,505 个参考视频上训练的相应 L16/L16 模型进行比较，并使用完整的 VBench 套件对两者进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Table 24 shows that Dynamic Degree increases by 7.78 points, while Motion Smoothness improves slightly by 0.13.
